remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated single-family home in the heart of Glenbrook, Stamford. This charming residence offers 4 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, perfect for families or anyone seeking comfort and convenience. Enjoy a sun-filled living room and a modern open-concept kitchen and dining area-ideal for daily living and entertaining. The kitchen features new stainless steel appliances, sleek quartz countertops, and modern finishes. Refinished hardwood floors flow throughout, adding warmth and character to every room. Located within walking distance to downtown Stamford and Stamford High School, just minutes from shopping, dining, bus lines, and more.  Live in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods-schedule your showing today!
